transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I feel like no matter how hard I plan and work, I’m just not good enough to get ahead. I’ve just been feeling so stuck and unmotivated with my job and my goals lately, and I finally realized I needed to talk to someone about it.
Have you been feeling this way for most of the last two years, or is this a more recent change that has lasted for a few weeks or months?

Honestly, it’s not a recent change at all. This heavy, discouraged feeling has pretty much been my constant baseline for about three years now, ever since I got passed over for that supervisor promotion. It just feels like I've been stuck in this rut for a really long time.

During these past three years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where your mood significantly worsened, or has this feeling of being 'stuck' been consistently present without any major breaks?

It has been consistently present without any real breaks or periods of feeling normal. It just feels like a continuous gray cloud has been hanging over me the entire three years, rather than coming and going in waves. It's just been a steady, heavy baseline.
During these past three years, have you consistently experienced other symptoms like changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels alongside this low mood?

Yes, my sleep has been a huge issue for the past three years, as I'll lie awake for hours worrying about work and money, only to wake up in the middle of the night feeling totally unrefreshed. While my appetite hasn't really changed, this terrible sleep leaves me feeling constantly tired and drained of energy. It just feels like I'm always running on empty.
Have you experienced persistent feelings of low self-esteem, hopelessness, or difficulty concentrating during these past three years?

Yes, I've struggled with all of those; I constantly feel like I'm not smart or good enough to get ahead, and this gray cloud makes me feel hopeless about things changing. My brain also feels like it's stuck in mud, to the point where I'll reread simple emails or stand in the supply closet completely forgetting what I went in for. This has really been my constant baseline ever since I missed out on that promotion three years ago.
Have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where your mood was much lower than this 'baseline' or where you lost interest in almost all activities?

No, I don't think I've had a specific two-week period where my mood dropped even lower than this. Instead, it has just been a steady, continuous heavy feeling and lack of motivation that has remained at this same level for the last three years.
